description: Source code for a GUI widget and functions related to geometric measurements in the BORIS behavioral observation software, including drawing points and lines, handling user interactions, and saving measurement results.

classes.name: wgMeasurement
classes.description: A dialog widget for performing and managing geometric measurements on images or videos within BORIS.

methods.name: show_widget
methods.description: Activates and displays the geometric measurement widget.

methods.name: draw_point
methods.description: Draws a point marker on the current frame image.

methods.name: draw_line
methods.description: Draws a line between two points on the current frame image.

methods.name: append_results
methods.description: Appends measurement results to the measurements table.

methods.name: image_clicked
methods.description: Handles user clicks on the image to create measurements like points, angles, polygons, and polylines.
